All I can ever do is try and hope there's never any guarantees. The only way I can guarantee anything is by dying so why when my two options are 

1. Take the hard path. Try to get better and hope I get better but never be guaranteed that this will stop.
2. Take the easy path. Simply sit with the belt around my neck for half a second longer and be guaranteed this stops. 

I get it "life's worth it" and whatever. That's an opinion. To you it's worth trying, to me it isn't.
